summary: Iter 12 retest after iter11 fixes — ALL 3 ReferenceErrors are RESOLVED. /demo/noldus, /demo/creator, /admin all render cleanly with ZERO console/page errors. Personalization renders correctly on Noldus (Welcome, Sarah from Acme. ×2), SITA (Welcome, Sarah from Acme.), and Creator (Welcome, Mia. ×2 — after fixing one secondary bug below). Admin Demo Delivery Engine section renders with stat cards + sessions table. ErrorBoundary verified — non-existent routes do not white-screen. HomePage all 5 sections present. Backend regression: 16/16 pytest pass. Session lifecycle, half-view notification, admin endpoints all green. Two demo pages (Creator, Insurance) take longer than 30–60s to fire /api/demo/session/start because handleStart awaits prefetchAll() (11 sequential TTS calls); not a wiring bug — Realtor + Noldus + SITA all fired session/start within window.

integration_issues.issue: session/start fires only AFTER handleStart awaits prefetchAll() (11 TTS calls). On a slow TTS network this can exceed 30–60s, so the tracking heartbeat is delayed. Wiring is correct (verified via Realtor + Noldus + SITA which all fired within 8–30s). Recommend fire-and-forget prefetch OR setStarted(true) before awaiting prefetch so session/start opens immediately on click intent.

action_items: (NICE-TO-HAVE) In CreatorDemoPage.handleStart and InsuranceDemoPage.handleStart, flip setStarted(true) BEFORE awaiting prefetchAll(), so /api/demo/session/start opens at click time rather than after 11 TTS prefetches finish. Currently the user click intent is not tracked until prefetch completes — slow-network leads will look like they bounced. (Realtor + Noldus + SITA do not have this delay.)
(NICE-TO-HAVE) CreatorDemoPage 1198 lines, NoldusDemoPage 1132 lines — still over the 700-line guideline. Split Hero / StartScreen / closing CTA into separate files.
